children: Farmers & Merchants Bank of Long Beach reported a Q3 2026 net loss of $36.8M after an $84.0M pre-tax loss from selling ~$991.9M HTM securities; net interest margin rose to 3.16% and net interest income to $89.1M. The bank expects full-year 2026 net income.
